title: 第9章 你想报仇吗第10章 倘若十五岁锻体已是天骄我儿三日开脉又当如何
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
“什么！你再说一遍，谁又来了！！”
神色恍惚的萧战天还没有反应，只听得一声怒吼猛然间炸响而起。
接着是众多拍碎桌子的剧烈声响接二连三响起，直接就把上来通报的萧家下人给吓懵逼了。
他只是一个通风报信的，您一个个别这样啊，我害怕···
“简直是欺人太甚，真将我萧家当软柿子随便捏了？”
“大哥，只要您一声令下，我这把老骨头立刻带人冲上去，我们萧家就没有窝囊软蛋！”
“对，没错！先天又如何，蚁多还咬死象呢，就算拼死也要给他一点颜色瞧瞧！”
众人愤慨的声音接二连三响起。
萧战天总算是回过了神来，心头的凄然让他比众人稍微冷静一些，不然平时叫嚷着要杀过去的那个人就是他了。
“稍安勿躁，你说清楚点，叶家的人不是刚走吗，为什么又返回来了？”
况且以他们走之前的嚣张样子，返回来的时候怎么可能会老老实实的叫人进来，而非强闯？
众人稍微冷静一些，都是敏感察觉到了事情的不对劲。
那名下人被众多萧家大人物给盯着，神态紧张，连连在自己脸上扇动巴掌。
“小的该死，是小的该死，没有说清楚，来人并非王都叶家，而是来自于白枫城的叶氏分家。”
白枫城叶家？
众人一愣，白枫城的叶家为什么会在这个节骨眼上找上门来，难不成是为了落井下石？
众人心头纷纷闪过各种疑惑。
“那不还是叶家吗，有什么好说的，依我看直接将他们赶走就完事了。”
“三弟不可，众所周知，白枫城的叶氏分家乃是叶族的三脉，在很久之前就已经被全部赶出叶氏宗族了，两者之间形同水火，或许对方此次前来并非坏消息。”
“否则也不会一前一后的赶来了。”

“我也觉得二哥说的有道理。”
萧战天眸子微微闪烁，随即对着下人道：“那就去将他们带进来吧，看看他们究竟想干什么再说。”
下人告退下去，众人看着重新坐回主位的萧战天，神色略微有些担忧。
“大哥，您这伤势要是让他们看见的话，会不会有些不太好啊。”
“那又如何，今日过后，我们萧家的脸面你以为还能在天香国保留多少。”
众人纷纷沉默，心中的悲戚更加浓郁了。
“仙儿，你先退下吧，爷爷这里没事。”
洛珺仙美丽的秋水瞳孔间虽然担忧之意不减，但也知道接下来的会面自己不方便出现，还是就乖巧地点点头后离开了。
稍许过后，在之前离开的下人引导之下，一行四人···
不。
如果算上那名尚在妇人襁褓中的婴儿的话，一行五人径直来到此前才发生过战役，连硝烟都未曾消散过去的大厅之中。
“萧大哥，别来无恙啊。”叶雄风双手抱拳，微笑道。
眼神一瞟，注意到那手臂上的异样，但却并未表现出来。
见他此举，的确并无恶意的模样，萧家众族老心中不由得升起一股奇异的荒诞之感。
他们在短短一个时辰之内竟然先后接待了两拨叶家的人，而且这两拨人还刚好是截然相反的态度，这怎能不令人心中唏嘘无比。
“叶老弟，说起来我们倒是的确有十几年间没有见过了。”
content_en:
"What! Say it again, who is coming again!!"
Xiao Zhantian, who was in a daze, had not yet reacted, only to hear a roar suddenly explode.
Then there were many violent sounds of smashing tables one after another, which immediately frightened the servants of the Xiao family who came up to report.
He is just a tipster. I am afraid that you are like this alone...
"That's just too much bullying. Do you really treat my Xiao family as a soft persimmon?"
"Brother, as long as you give the order, I, an old man, will lead people to rush forward immediately. There will be no wimps in our Xiao family!"
"Yes, that's right! It doesn't matter what you're born with. There are so many ants that they can bite an elephant to death. Even if you risk your life, you have to show him some color!"
The angry voices of everyone sounded one after another.
Xiao Zhantian finally came to his senses, and the sadness in his heart made him a little calmer than everyone else, otherwise he would be the one who usually shouted to kill.
"Don't be impatient. Please explain clearly. Didn't the Ye family just leave? Why did they come back?"
Besides, with how arrogant they were before leaving, how could they honestly ask people in instead of forcing their way in when they returned?
Everyone was a little calmer, they were all sensitive to the fact that something was wrong.
The servant was stared at by many important figures of the Xiao family, and he looked nervous and slapped himself in the face repeatedly.
"Damn it, damn it. I didn't make it clear that the person coming was not the Ye family in the royal capital, but the branch of the Ye family from Bai Maple City."
The Ye family in Bai Maple City?
Everyone was stunned. Why did the Ye family from Bai Maple City come to visit them at this juncture? Could it be to add insult to injury?
Various doubts flashed through everyone's minds.
"Isn't that still the Ye family? What's there to say? In my opinion, just drive them away and that's it."
"Third brother is not allowed. As we all know, the Ye family branch in Bai Maple City is the third branch of the Ye family. All of them were kicked out of the Ye family a long time ago. The two are like fire and water. Maybe the other party's coming this time is not bad news."
"Otherwise, we wouldn't have come one after another."
"I also think what the second brother said makes sense."
Xiao Zhantian's eyes flickered slightly, and then he said to the servant: "Then go and bring them in, and see what they want to do."
The servants retired, and everyone looked at Xiao Zhantian, who had returned to his seat, with slightly worried expressions.
"Brother, if you let them see your injury, wouldn't it be a little bad?"
"So what? After today, how much face do you think our Xiao family can retain in Tianxiang Kingdom?"
Everyone fell silent, and the sadness in their hearts became even stronger.
"Xian'er, please step back first. Grandpa is fine here."
Although the worry in Luo Junxian's beautiful Qiu Shui's pupils did not diminish, she knew that it would be inconvenient for her to appear in the next meeting, so she nodded obediently and left.
After a while, under the guidance of the servants who had left before, a group of four...
No.
If you include the woman's infant baby, the group of five people went straight to the hall where a battle had just taken place before and even the smoke of gunpowder had not dissipated.
"Brother Xiao, you're fine." Ye Xiongfeng clasped his hands in his fists and said with a smile.
He glanced at it and noticed something strange on the arm, but he didn't show it.
Seeing that there was indeed no malice in his actions, the elders of the Xiao family couldn't help but feel a strange sense of absurdity in their hearts.
In just one hour, they actually received two groups of people from the Ye family, and the two groups happened to have completely opposite attitudes. How could this not make people feel extremely sad?
"Brother Ye, it's true that we haven't seen each other for more than ten years."
